panels.description: Leona lifts the Covenant band while Ada remains across the room. Leave upper space for dialogue.
Ada places a public review notice between them on the table. Keep the notice unobstructed.
Leona signs the notice. Leave upper area for the status text.
Leona leaves her seat empty and walks with Ada toward the civic hall. Keep the physical distance narrowing but not reconciled; leave upper space.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: Then stay where people can answer you.
LEONA VEYRA — SUBJECT TO PUBLIC CHALLENGE
